truncatedText.$description: TruncatedText's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--truncated-text-<name>) on the page, a container or one TruncatedText, and every TruncatedText inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

focus-ring.$description: The ring inside its edge while cut text has keyboard focus.
